priorityList: Sync Shadow Blades with Shadow Dance and Secret Technique for maximum burst.
Cast Shadow Dance only when Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Secret Technique as your top priority finisher during Shadow Dance.
Use Eviscerate as your finisher whenever Darkest Night is active to consume the proc.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown.
Use Black Powder as your finisher against 3 or more targets (unless Darkest Night is active).
Use Eviscerate as your finisher against 1 or 2 targets.
Cast Shadowstrike as your primary builder if Deathstalker's Mark is missing from the target.
Use Shuriken Storm as your builder when 2 or more targets are present.
Use Shadowstrike as your builder if Darkest Night is active and there are 4 or fewer targets.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Use Vanish to enter stealth and generate Combo Points if you have 1 or fewer Combo Points.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Shadow Blades.
Spend Combo Points on finishers when you reach 6 or more (or 7 if Darkest Night is active).
Use Shuriken Storm at the start of Shadow Dance if Premeditation is active to benefit from Danse Macabre.
